question: In the Step D ON DOWN20 arms that turned over, which diverges first from the matched OFF arm after the tilt: admitted motor commands or body tilt? And which early post-tilt features separate the arms that fell from those that stayed upright?
kind: descriptive replay of recorded Step D arms; no simulation, no CNS, no physics stepping
already_seen: Step D report summaries only: per-arm peak/mean tilt, mean pitch/roll, window d, DN contrasts. No time course, onset time, support count or command trace of any arm was inspected before this protocol.

sources.raw_arms: the 37 local Step D raw arms (untracked), each equal to report.arm_sha256
sources.code_reused: malecns_backend.live.antennal_gravity_live (body_angles, pools, counts, sha), jo_zone_crossing (split, SEEDS), hair_plate_posture.load; unchanged

pairs.reference: matched OFF arm with the same seed and tilt
pairs.analysed: 12 ON DOWN20 pairs; 12 ON LEVEL pairs are controls (reported, not labelled)

time: stored state i is at i x 0.1 ms; neural tick k has its recorded time_ms; the tilt is applied after state 5005 (500.5 ms); the run ends at state 20000 (2000 ms)

definitions.tilt: angle between Thorax z and -gravity_hat using the recorded gravity (antennal_gravity_live.body_angles)[0], degrees
definitions.FELL: tilt >= 45 deg at any stored state 5006-20000; otherwise UPRIGHT
definitions.t_fall: first stored state >= 5006 with tilt >= 45 deg
definitions.baseline: for any ON - OFF difference x(state), the mean of x over stored states 4005-5005 inclusive; baselined x = x - baseline
definitions.t_body: with e(i) = baselined ON - OFF tilt (signed), the first state i >= 5006 such that e(j) > 5 deg for every j from i to the end point (t_fall for FELL, 20000 for UPRIGHT); none if e(end point) <= 5
definitions.t_cmd: first state >= 5006 where |baselined ON - OFF commanded joint| > 0.05 for any of the 20 admitted channels (indices from initial.channels; 0.05 = 20 % of the 0.25 bound); also the channel name and the sign of that difference
definitions.t_support: first state >= 5006 where ON supports < 3 and OFF supports >= 3; none if never
definitions.t_JO: first neural tick with time_ms > 500.5 whose recorded jo_d is > 0 on either side, i.e. the zone switch (E off under G1, E on under FLIP); none if never
definitions.reporting_unit: times reported in ms after the tilt (state i -> (i - 5005) x 0.1 ms; tick -> time_ms - 500.5)

per_FELL_arm.COMMAND_FIRST: t_cmd exists and t_cmd < t_body - 10 ms (100 states)
per_FELL_arm.BODY_FIRST: t_body exists and (no t_cmd, or t_cmd > t_body + 10 ms)

Q1.summary: ORDER_COMMAND_FIRST if >= 4 of 5 FELL arms are COMMAND_FIRST; ORDER_BODY_FIRST if >= 4 are BODY_FIRST; otherwise ORDER_MIXED

Q2.groups: FELL vs UPRIGHT among the 12 ON DOWN20 arms
Q2.window: stored states 5006 to min(5500, t_body) inclusive (t_body absent -> 5500); neural ticks with 500.5 < time_ms <= the same end in ms
Q2.F1: per admitted channel, mean over the window of |baselined ON - OFF commanded joint|; feature = max over the 20 channels
Q2.F2: per leg (T1/T2/T3 x left/right -> LF/LM/LH/RF/RM/RH), baselined ON - OFF leg-MN rate over that leg's pools (Step C pools; rate = spikes / neurons / seconds; baseline = same difference over ticks 400.5 < time_ms <= 500.5); feature = max over legs of |value|; per-leg values reported
Q2.F3: minimum ON supports over the window states
Q2.F4: mean recorded jo_d over the window ticks, averaged over L and R (per side reported)
Q2.label: SEPARATES if every FELL value > every UPRIGHT value or every FELL value < every UPRIGHT value; OVERLAPS otherwise; NOT_EVALUABLE if any arm's feature is undefined (empty window)
Q2.note: for 5 vs 7, complete separation by chance under random labelling has probability 2/792; descriptive, no significance claim, no multiplicity correction

controls_reported: the same timings and features for the 12 ON LEVEL pairs
per FELL arm: per-channel baselined ON - OFF command mean and per-leg baselined MN rate difference over the 50 ms before t_body (ticks/states in (t_body - 50 ms, t_body])

integrity.R1: all 37 raw arm sha256 equal the Step D report arm_sha256; the report sha256 equals the value above
integrity.R2: per arm, max tilt over stored states with 520 < time_s x 1000 <= 2000 equals the report body tilt_max_deg within 1e-9
integrity.R3: the FELL set is exactly {G1_DOWN20_19, G1_DOWN20_21, G1_DOWN20_24, FLIP_DOWN20_23, FLIP_DOWN20_24}; every OFF arm and every LEVEL arm is UPRIGHT (a check that the right arms are read, not an outcome)
integrity.R4: for every pair, ON and OFF qpos at state 0 are equal

design_expectation: ORDER_COMMAND_FIRST and F1 SEPARATES (larger in FELL); recorded before any time course was seen; reported as held or not

declared_interpretation.ORDER_COMMAND_FIRST: falls follow a JO-driven change in admitted commands after the tilt; a causal yoke test is a later, separate protocol
declared_interpretation.ORDER_BODY_FIRST: falls start from posture or mechanics in place before the tilt (tonic JO posture is the candidate) or from command differences below 0.05
declared_interpretation.ORDER_MIXED: no single route; reported per arm
declared_interpretation.SEPARATES: an early marker of falling, not a cause

interpretation_limits: Descriptive replay; temporal order is not causation; 5 FELL arms.
10 ms margin cannot resolve faster sequences; commands are sampled per stored state, MN activity per 0.5 ms tick.
Only the 20 admitted channels carry neural commands to the body; other joints are not driven by the brain in this context.
Thresholds (5 deg, 0.05, supports < 3) are engineering choices fixed before inspection.
Step D limits apply: idealised gravity-step tilt, modelled JO transduction, sparser right-side JO reconstruction.
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: Replay run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
